reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 original B1/B2 verb/phrase exercises: checked complete German sentences, conjugation, reflexive constructions and prepositions, every distractor, unique accepted answers, bilingual hints/explanations and distinct contexts. Reviewed pinned source labels and production/initial/B2/workplace/general-expansion objectives, plus earlier sich richten an and related lexical targets. Corrected misleading inherited English glosses and constructions. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending. Second editorial pass improved idiomatic vornehmen and siezen constructions, clarified visual sightseeing, and replaced a potentially overlapping umsehen distractor for umhören. Final full-sentence check repaired an infinitive construction with um ... zu and aligned tense in the siezen example.
